$comment: R02 test catalog. Every scripts/_test-*.ts must appear here exactly once (run-tests.mjs --check enforces it in CI). `helper` = imported by other tests, never run on its own. Lanes: unit | db | scheduler | browser | manual. See docs/titanor-time/TEST_CATALOG_RU.md.

lanes.unit: No database, no browser. Pure functions or mocked globals (fake-indexeddb, mocked fetch/caches). Runs anywhere, no env.
lanes.db: Needs a disposable PostgreSQL 16 with every migration applied. Direct route-handler / lib calls — no HTTP server. run-tests.mjs gives each test its own fresh database cloned from a migrated template.
lanes.scheduler: Same runtime as `db`, but the subject under test is a scheduler tick / horizon / auto-close pass. Run together with the db lane.
lanes.browser: Needs a running standalone server (TEST_BASE_URL) and usually Chromium (playwright). Not part of the unattended CI gate — runs at pilot acceptance (R12 / TZ 18.2 item 10).
lanes.manual: Excluded from every automated gate. See the per-test note for why and how to run it.
